prompt: Add a safe command surface around all current data scripts in this Python repository. Include the recommended dataset command and clearly labeled legacy extract/interim commands, expose an incomplete validation script without pretending it works, and make every command discoverable through --help. Use the project's packaging conventions, avoid shelling out to source scripts, preserve raw data immutability, and report any unsupported command explicitly. Update the agent and contributor command references and run a smoke test with temporary input data.
assertions: Help output exposes the recommended dataset command and clearly labeled extract, interim, and validation commands.
The incomplete validation path fails explicitly with an actionable unsupported/incomplete message instead of returning success.
The CLI calls real repository functions or gives a documented limitation; it does not shell out to source scripts or rewrite raw data.
AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md contain synchronized command references and identify the recommended versus legacy paths.
A temporary-input smoke run or focused test provides evidence for at least one real command and its exit behavior.
